verdict.rationale: Ente Auth documents no user-configurable automation feature that runs autonomously in the background. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit. The automatic daily backup is a fixed built-in toggle that only runs "when you open the app," so it is neither background nor user-defined. The CLI "automatic backup" is export tooling a user would have to schedule externally, which is a building block or workaround rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
